method.filtering_summary: Live search at about 7:37 AM EAT on 16 sources pulled 2,580 postings (ReliefWeb failed again, and Wellfound's automated fetch is switched off on purpose, so it is checked in Ben's signed-in browser separately). 1712 were older than 7 days and 50 were old reposts, 227 senior or excluded titles, 184 not target roles, 186 excluded Kenya, 18 already applied and 73 duplicates, leaving 130. Roles already shown in earlier briefings were skipped, including G2i's talent pools and Canonical's observability role. Jobgether answered live (495 offers, 199 from the last 7 days, 21 kept by the script), but every new engineering offer was tied to one European country, so none made the list. micro1 answered live (65 pulled, 15 kept by the script); the new roles are mostly specialist engineering-expert work (aerospace, CAD, electronics, SysML), and the only one near his stack is the Panda3D Python role, listed as a stretch. Jobicy answered but every date looked like a bump date.

stories.title: Mistral publishes open weights for Mistral Large 4
stories.summary: The 1 trillion-parameter multimodal model (52 billion active) is on Hugging Face and via API; Mistral says it is the top open model on Artificial Analysis' Coding Agent Index and scored 41% on Terminal-Bench 4.0.
stories.why: A strong open-weight coding model he can self-host is useful for agent builds and for fintech clients that want code and data kept in-house.

stories.title: Grok Bot hits 800,000 paid weekly users as Musk flags serving costs
stories.summary: SpaceX said Grok Bot reached 800,000 paid weekly users in early October, double September; Musk wrote that "the cost of serving Grok Bot was unsustainably high relative to revenue."
stories.why: Agent products are scaling fast but are expensive to run, so engineers who can make agents efficient are in demand.

stories.title: Grok Bot preview build tests usage resets in exchange for training data
stories.summary: A leak from prerelease build 1.1.0-pre.12 shows a "Get additional Grok Bot usage" prompt offering a reset if users allow their interactions to train SpaceXSI's models; it may not ship.
stories.why: Shows how agent companies are trying to balance usage limits, cost and data, which matters for anyone building on these tools.

stories.title: Fal raises $1.3B at a $16B valuation
stories.summary: The AI inference startup's Series F was led by Bessemer with Nvidia, Sound Ventures and T. Rowe Price; it doubles April's $8 billion valuation, and Fal passed $800 million in annualized revenue.
stories.why: Inference platforms are among the fastest-growing AI employers and keep hiring engineers who integrate open models.

stories.title: Traversal raises $120M at a $1B valuation for AI site-reliability agents
stories.summary: Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint and Khosla led the round; Traversal grew revenue more than nine-fold in a year and says it will accelerate engineering hiring.
stories.why: Another well-funded agentic-AI company growing its engineering team.

stories.title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M for a behavioral world model
stories.summary: The Israeli startup says its model, which predicts how traders act, already runs at 10 large brokerages; the money came from founders and Infinity Group over three years.
stories.why: AI aimed at financial decision-making sits close to his fintech background.

stories.title: Dice: US tech postings up 20% year over year, AI/ML up 91%
stories.summary: Tech job postings rose 4% month over month in October; AI and machine-learning postings grew 91% year over year, with AI Trainers and MLOps engineers among the fastest-growing titles.
stories.why: AI skills are where hiring is growing fastest, which is exactly where his CV is pointed.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs: workers laid off by AI take about a month longer to find work
stories.summary: Workers most likely displaced by AI in 2025 took roughly a month longer to find new jobs and were about 10 points more likely to still be unemployed a year later.
stories.why: A reminder that building AI skills, rather than competing with automation, is the safer path.

stories.title: Safaricom plans Tunza Biashara business-asset cover from KSh1,700 a year
stories.summary: Safaricom's NextGen Fintech Group says the cover for small traders will be sold through the M-PESA Business Hub "soon"; M-PESA revenue rose 13.4% to KSh182.7 billion.
stories.why: M-PESA keeps adding financial products, which means more fintech integration work in Kenya.

stories.title: Kenya-based fintech Yiksi gets South African FSCA authorisation
stories.summary: Yiksi's South African entity is now a Category I Financial Services Provider for crypto assets (FSP 55213), supporting its stablecoin wallet and cross-border payments push.
stories.why: A Nairobi-headquartered fintech expanding across Africa is a possible employer to watch.
